unresolvedQuestions: What is the non-refundable down payment AMOUNT? It is required 'today' and is non-refundable, but the figure appears nowhere.
Can Step Up PEP/UA scholarships be applied to camp tuition? Never addressed.
Is there a sibling discount? Never addressed.
Does every camper perform, or 'may' they?
Which unit number is the camp actually held in - 1157 or 117?
Will there be a 2027 camp? Both 2026 sessions have passed and all pages still solicit reservations.
What happens to the non-refundable deposit if the academy cancels a session? Not addressed.
Is there an allergy or dietary policy for the 'Daily Snacks Included'? Not addressed.
Is there a medical, emergency-contact, or pickup-authorisation form? None published.
